candidates.title: The Concert Hall That Swallowed Music
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the new concert hall sounded strangely quiet even with a full orchestra during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but the players performed louder but listeners at the back still heard almost nothing; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized temporary sound-absorbing rehearsal curtains covered the reflective wall panels; they planned a safer joint response.

With the community helpers watching, they repositioned the curtains with the hall crew and checked sound from every row, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Fish That Missed Every Meal
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the pond fish gathered for food long after the automatic feeder had stopped during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they filled the feeder again but it still released food at the wrong hour; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized its display used twelve-hour time and the feeding cycle had been set to midnight; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they corrected the clock setting and observed a safe daytime feeding, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Race That Never Reached the Finish
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the charity runners kept arriving at the same water station twice during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they painted larger finish arrows but the returning runners stayed confused; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized the loop's turnaround point had been put beyond the crossing instead of before it; they planned a safer joint response.

With the community helpers watching, they moved the checkpoint and had volunteers walk the full course before restarting, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
